input_contract.unknown_preferences: null;never infer household preferred times from A feasibility alone

objects.service_requirement: independent service,quantity,release,deadline;comfort target only when given
objects.thermostat_policy: declared household control habit;separate from actual room presence
objects.A_operating_reference: current A forecast plus model,weather,initial_state and forecaster hashes
objects.opportunity_catalogue: A operating/service opportunity,original resource bounds and source hashes
objects.frozen_scenario: external_event or resource_conditioned_joint_scene;all construction dependencies recorded
objects.plan_B: explicit experiment mechanism and native device requests;actual executable differences from current A

fresh_generation.on_A_change: invalidate all downstream derived references;do not reuse parent A forecast

fixed_intervention_replay.on_A_change: preserve intervention assignment but recompute all current-context claims and outcomes;old opportunity evidence is provenance only

VPP_scene_modes.external_event: freeze event before household opportunities;no shifting clocks to fill missing opportunity
VPP_scene_modes.resource_conditioned_joint_scene: construct scene from A resources and declared action/dose design;freeze jointly before final B simulation;not observed dispatch frequency

device_action_contracts.washer_dishwasher: noninterruptible whole programme chain;loader/run/retrieval,full occupation,operator,wait,deadline;manual burden is a separate axis
device_action_contracts.AC: actual occupancy,comfort need,habit permission,command setpoints and measured temperature remain distinct;restore baseline outside intervention
device_action_contracts.water_heater: actual draw need,water delivery and heater state/headroom;setpoint change is not guaranteed electricity or comfort effect
device_action_contracts.EV: original travel,target and plug/unplug fixed;control inside real connection;continuous SOC and later recovery checked

allowed: declared experimental design and deterministic seed
not_used_for_postselection: final paired EnergyPlus saving or success
selection_information_policy.required_disclosure: B60 does use candidate-effect prediction;do not describe it as entirely outcome-blind

failure_policy.data_or_model_construction_error: repair upstream in new recorded run;never label it a valid B preference case
failure_policy.designed_or_joint_request_failure: keep proposal and its execution consequences;no successful replacement
failure_policy.no_realized_effect: record separately from identical commands;do not manufacture manual actions
failure_policy.soft_household_preference_violation: retain for human judgment;not an automatic data validity filter
